events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church spreads from Jerusalem; the Jerusalem meeting about Gentile believers is about AD 49.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Claudius is emperor (AD 41 to 54); Thessalonica is the capital of Macedonia; Gallio governs Achaia.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written from Corinth, about AD 50 to 51

teaser.title: Paul founds the church
teaser.text: Paul preaches in Thessalonica for a short time and is forced out, about AD 49 to 50 (Acts 17:1-9).

teaser.title: 1 Thessalonians is written
teaser.text: Paul writes from Corinth, about AD 50 to 51, among the earliest of his surviving letters.

teaser.title: A second letter follows
teaser.text: Paul soon writes again to correct a misunderstanding about the Lord's coming (2 Thessalonians).

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.
